head.name: @fzlt/core/aim
head.lead: Where bots and turrets point and when they may fire. Bound once to body arrays (a @fzlt/core/actor's or a steer's x, y, heading a, velocity vx, vy) and, for line of sight, a @fzlt/core/grid board; then everything takes rows: - lead(i, j, speed): where i must shoot a shot of speed px/s to meet j, moving at (vx, vy): the intercept of a straight shot and a straight mover, the earliest one ahead; - cone(i, j, half, range): j inside i's heading ± half radians and within range; - sees(i, j): no mask cell strictly between them on the board (Bresenham, symmetric), or the game's own clear(i, j); - pick(i, list, n, half, range): the nearest foe of i among list[0..n) in its cone and in sight (an actor table's list and n as they are). Results land in out[0..3] ([x, y, t, d]: aim point, seconds to impact or the off-heading angle, and distance), so no call returns a double: doubles returned or passed across a call V8 doesn't inline are boxed. Distances are @fzlt/core/steer's exact hypot (Math.hypot's bits, no heap number). DOM-free, stateless between calls, zero allocation.

sizesNote: Measured on this build: minified and gzipped with everything it imports, the way npm run size checks the budget in CI.
